text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py: it loads sent messages and gateway delivery status, builds the set of households whose message was delivered (excluded from re-texting), and re-queues each failed message once via queue_sms with the original template_id and params, letting queue_sms handle id assignment, timestamp, phone, and rendering. Ran it once; it re-sent 9 failed SMS messages (within the expected 8-10), one per affected household, and no delivered household was texted.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
